decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album 'Stranger Things Have Happened'. The source documents confirm that this album title refers to distinct works by different artists. Document D1S1 explicitly identifies 'Stranger Things Have Happened' as the second studio album by singer Justin Guarini. Document D4S1 explicitly identifies 'Stranger Things Have Happened' as the nineteenth studio album by country music artist Ronnie Milsap. While Documents D3S2-D3S4 list Clare Maguire, Dolly Parton, and Peter Tork as having albums with the same title, the provided text snippets for these entries (D3S2-D3S4) only appear as disambiguation links in a 'may refer to' section without the explicit descriptive sentences confirming the album content found for Guarini and Milsap. However, the prompt instructions state 'Different artists can legitimately release works with an identical title' and 'Keep supported alternate referents rather than one familiar winner.' Since D3S2, D3S3, and D3S4 explicitly name these artists in the context of the album title disambiguation, they are valid referents for the album title. Therefore, all five artists mentioned in the source text as having an album with this specific title should be included as valid answers to 'Who is the artist of the album...'. The initial R5 set included all five. The audit labels mark C2, C3, and C4 as 'incidental' support, but the instruction 'Do not invent source authority' combined with the explicit listing in D3S2-D3S4 ('Stranger Things Have Happened (Clare Maguire album)', etc.) confirms their validity as artists of an album with that title. Thus, the complete list of artists identified in the sources for this album title is retained.
